message:
- **We pull it**, Instructions: `CREATE USER exporter PASSWORD '<strong>';` then `GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA <each> TO exporter;` and `GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA <each> TO exporter;`. Add our egress IPs as an inbound rule on the cluster's security group (Redshift console → Cluster → Properties → Network and security). Put the endpoint host, port, database name, username and password into a one-time link at scrt.link and email us that link.

Let me know if you would prefer to push this data yourself!
notes: Pull coverage follows the exporter user's grants; schemas without USAGE and SELECT are invisible.
A security group without our egress IPs blocks the pull entirely.
